records.text: A commenter using the name Keeping the Faith with Father Joseph offered the opinion that normal-looking car proportions would indicate normal person proportions in the disputed image.
records.speaker: Keeping the Faith with Father Joseph (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: That is very true and thank you for that. Keeping the faith with Father Joseph writes, for those who are unsure of whether the courtroom footage or your photo are real, For those who are unsure of whether the courtroom footage or your photo are real, meaning did Candace stretch the person who was actually skating reality, what is undeniable is the cars. ... Normal size cars equals normal size person in my opinion. Oh, are you trying on common sense, Father Joseph?

verification.notes: The episode presents a viewer opinion, but searches did not independently recover the original comment. No calibrated image analysis is supplied; apparent car proportions do not authenticate the image or identify the person.
